title: Using the Python zip() Function for Parallel Iteration
description: Learn how to use the Python zip() function to iterate over multiple iterables in parallel, unzip sequences, and build dictionaries with less code.
summary: Python’s zip() function combines elements from multiple iterables . Calling zip() generates an iterator that yields tuples, each containing elements from the input iterables.
